not_fixed_here: hop 0 from stand-in sources (cko not inverted in these variants) and the DFF stand-in stations (half: hbm st->st setup -237.6 TT from the stand-in LCB 1.2 ns slew) -- both answered on the rebound case die_p4j_land2_r (all stations closed relay views, hop-0 source contract)
decision: CHOSEN (a) half-cycle hops: setup >= +198.6 on every relay hop at TT (rule >= +100) and hold >= +210.7 TT / +226.5 FF; (b) leaves +5.4 / +22.2 ps hold margin (no room for wire variation) and does not shorten the lane. Half-cycle hops halve the station latency (N stations cost N/2 root cycles).
duty_cycle_note: half-cycle hops time against the falling edge; every station inverts, so rise/fall asymmetry alternates and does not accumulate along a lane; the >= +198 ps setup margin covers a duty-cycle budget of several tens of ps
